datasets.name: downloads
queryLines: SELECT download_id, event_time, event_date, workspace_id, user_email, channel, download_kind, action_name, rows_returned, read_bytes, source_ip, ip_status, ip_attribution, pii_evidence, pii_columns, pii_tag_values FROM fct_data_downloads

datasets.name: suspicious
queryLines: SELECT download_id, event_time, event_date, workspace_id, user_email, channel, download_kind, action_name, rows_returned, read_bytes, source_ip, ip_status, ip_attribution, pii_evidence, pii_columns, pii_tag_values, reasons, risk_score FROM suspicious_downloads

datasets.name: daily
queryLines: SELECT event_date, workspace_id, channel, download_kind, downloads, users, rows_downloaded, pii_downloads, untrusted_ip_downloads, large_downloads, suspicious_downloads FROM daily_download_summary

datasets.name: pii_tags
queryLines: SELECT event_date, channel, user_email, tag AS pii_tag FROM fct_data_downloads LATERAL VIEW explode(pii_tag_values) t AS tag WHERE pii_evidence IN ('column', 'table')

datasets.name: ips
queryLines: SELECT event_date, channel, source_ip, ip_status, user_email, download_id FROM fct_data_downloads WHERE source_ip IS NOT NULL

datasets.name: freshness
queryLines: SELECT max(event_time) AS last_download_time, count(*) AS total_downloads FROM fct_data_downloads
